post.title: Rehall: Scaling E-Commerce Through Custom Architecture & High-Converting Design
post.excerpt: A bespoke Shopify build for a Dutch skiwear brand: a pixel-perfect theme, carefully integrated apps and a buying journey with less friction.

yoast.title: Rehall Shopify Case Study: Custom Theme & Apps | AvixDigital
yoast.metadesc: Rehall Shopify case study: how we turned a high-fidelity skiwear design into a fast, scalable store with smart navigation, spec filters and integrated apps.

meta.display_title: Rehall: Scaling Shopify E-Commerce Through [Custom Architecture] & High-Converting Design
meta.summary: Rehall needed a digital storefront that didn't just serve as a visual catalogue, but acted as a high-performance sales engine. We turned a static, high-fidelity design into a dynamic, scalable Shopify ecosystem built for revenue.
meta.challenge_statement: The primary hurdle in modern e-commerce is bridging the gap between [premium aesthetic design] and elite technical performance.
challenge_body: Rehall designs technical ski and snowboard outerwear for men, women and kids, and sells it directly across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. The brief was not another pretty catalogue: the storefront had to behave like a high-performance sales engine, turning a static, high-fidelity design into a dynamic, scalable Shopify ecosystem built to maximise revenue.

The challenge for Rehall was to implement a pixel-perfect design and integrate essential third-party applications without introducing code bloat, slowing down page speed, or creating friction in the buying journey.
Premium visuals plus the apps a modern fashion brand relies on usually mean heavier pages and a slower path to checkout, exactly the kind of drag a seasonal brand can least afford.
meta.constraints: Pixel-perfect design, Third-party apps, Core Web Vitals, No checkout friction
meta.approach_intro: Led by founder Akib Zawayed, we engineered a bespoke Shopify environment focused on speed, seamless third-party functionality and user-centric navigation.
approach_body: We treated speed and clarity as design features, not afterthoughts. Every screen in the approved design was rebuilt as a lightweight, fully responsive custom Shopify theme in clean Liquid, so the brand stays razor-sharp whether a shopper is on a laptop at home or a phone in the lift queue.

Third-party functionality was added deliberately, through meticulous API work, so each new feature extended Shopify without dragging down Core Web Vitals. Then we restructured product discovery and checkout around how people actually buy skiwear: by who it is for, by garment, by fit and by technical performance.
implementations: Pixel-Perfect Design Conversion: Translated complex UI/UX designs into a fully responsive, lightweight Shopify theme. We ensured the brand's visual identity remained razor-sharp and engaging across all mobile and desktop devices.

Strategic App Integration: Seamlessly integrated custom third-party applications to extend Shopify's native functionality. This required meticulous API implementation to ensure the new features worked flawlessly without compromising Core Web Vitals or site speed.

Conversion-Optimised Architecture: Restructured the product discovery and checkout flows. By utilising clean Liquid code and prioritising intuitive navigation, we eliminated user friction points to actively reduce cart abandonment.
solution_body: The result is a bespoke Shopify environment focused on speed, seamless app functionality and user-centric navigation.
meta.outcome_statement: The architectural overhaul directly translated into [proven, measurable sales growth].
outcome_body: By delivering a lightning-fast, visually compelling, and frictionless shopping experience, the Rehall.com platform successfully maximised its conversion rate. The resulting infrastructure now provides a robust, future-proof foundation for scaling their operations and driving sustained revenue.
That foundation is visible today: the store trades its Winter 26 collection in English, Dutch and German on Shopify, with new campaigns and categories added season after season.

features.title: Six Shopify details that do the selling

spotlights.title: A mega menu that shops like a [ski store]
spotlights.problem: A deep range of jackets, pants, suits, base layers and technical lines across four audiences can bury products several clicks deep.
spotlights.built: Hovering Shop opens a mega menu split by Men, Women, Boys and Girls. Every category for that audience sits one hover away, and half the panel goes to editorial campaign tiles, so discovery feels like browsing a store rather than reading a sitemap.

hotspots.label: Shop by audience: Men, Women, Boys, Girls
Editorial campaign tiles inside the menu

spotlights.title: Search that answers [while you type]
spotlights.problem: Shoppers who arrive knowing what they want shouldn't have to wade through a results page to see what fits.
spotlights.built: Typing opens a predictive panel under the header: query suggestions on the left, live product results on the right with sale prices and star ratings, and a View all shortcut for the full list.

hotspots.label: Sale prices and ratings at a glance

spotlights.title: Filters built on [technical specs], not just size and colour
spotlights.problem: Skiwear is bought on performance. Without spec-level filters, customers open product after product to compare waterproof and breathability ratings.
spotlights.built: Collection pages pair a filter app, styled into the theme, with Rehall's product data: size with live stock counts, colour swatches, waterproofness in mm, breathability, and features such as a snow skirt or ski-pass pocket. Regular, Baggy and DXR fit tiles sit above the grid.

hotspots.label: Size filter with live stock counts

spotlights.title: A buy box that removes [the last doubts]
spotlights.problem: Choosing a colourway, finding out a size is sold out only after clicking, and hunting for delivery terms are classic reasons to leave a product page.
spotlights.built: Every colourway is a real product photo, sold-out sizes are struck through in the size bar, and the delivery promise sits right under a full-width Add to cart: same-day dispatch before 5 p.m., free shipping from €250 and 14-day returns.

hotspots.label: Delivery and returns promise at the button

spotlights.title: Technical specs, [made readable]
spotlights.problem: A 20,000 mm water column and 20,000 g/m²/24h breathability mean little to most shoppers, yet they're why people buy a premium ski jacket.
spotlights.built: A Features tab turns product data into three visual meters for warmth, breathability and water resistance, followed by a clean details table. The buy box stays pinned beside it while shoppers read.

hotspots.label: Spec table driven by product data
Buy box stays in view while reading

spotlights.title: A cart drawer that [keeps people buying]
spotlights.problem: Cart abandonment often starts in the cart itself: a dead end with no reassurance and no next step.
spotlights.built: The slide-out smart cart adds a "Recommended for you" product, the Trustpilot rating, the order-before-17:00 same-day dispatch message and every accepted payment method, from Shop Pay and Klarna to Amex, right where the decision happens.

hotspots.label: Trust signal at the decision point
